title: Hold a food safety scheme accreditation
what: Produce primary produce covered by a food safety scheme (such as meat, dairy, seafood or eggs) only under an accreditation from Safe Food Production Queensland.

sources.title: Food Production (Safety) Act 2000 (Qld)
sources.quote: The person must not engage in the production of the primary produce other than under an accreditation

reach.condition: if a food safety scheme applies to its primary produce (such as meat, dairy, seafood or eggs)

reach.condition: if it produces eggs for sale
